lines.witnessed: You were there in {place} and saw it with your own eyes: {beat}.
lines.witnessedFar: Word of it reached the deck from close by: {beat}.
lines.participant: You were in the thick of it when it happened: {beat}.
lines.missed: The years went by and it never came to pass: {beat}.
lines.substituted: {name} stood where another should have stood: {beat}.
lines.delayed: {name} was elsewhere, and the hour of it slipped: {beat}.
lines.roleAway: {name} could not get there in time
lines.requirement: what had to come first never happened
lines.earlyDeathNews: {name} is dead, years before anyone thought. The seas will not be the same.
lines.fruitReturns: Somewhere, the {fruit} that {name} held has returned to the world.
lines.crewEnds: With nobody to lead them, the {crew} broke apart.
